```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Printable drone sign-out sheet, rebuilt from the old "Drone Checkout.xlsx".
# Edit COLUMNS / ROWS and re-render with `quarto render drone_checkout.qmd`.

# (header, width in Excel column units, is a checkbox column)
COLUMNS = [
    ("Name",                          16.0, False),
    ("Drone",                         15.8, False),
    ("Checkout date/time",            15.0, False),
    ("Areas being flown",             26.8, False),
    ("Anticipated return date/time",  15.0, False),
    ("Return date/time",              15.0, False),
    ("Charging batteries?",           10.5, True),
]

ROWS = 15
HEADER_HEIGHT = "32pt"
ROW_HEIGHT = "30pt"

total = sum(width for _, width, _ in COLUMNS)
# \tabcolsep is applied on both sides of every column, so take it out of the
# share each column gets of \linewidth. The leading zero-width column only
# holds a strut that sets the row height, centered so the m-columns sit in
# the middle of the row.
specs = r"@{}l@{\hspace{\tabcolsep}}" + "|".join(
    rf">{{\centering\arraybackslash}}m{{\dimexpr {width / total:.4f}\linewidth - 2\tabcolsep - \arrayrulewidth\relax}}"
    for _, width, _ in COLUMNS
)

header = " & ".join(rf"\textbf{{{name}}}" for name, _, _ in COLUMNS)
blank = r"\fbox{\rule{0pt}{0.9em}\hspace{0.9em}}"
row = " & ".join(blank if is_box else "" for _, _, is_box in COLUMNS)

def strut(height):
    return rf"\rule[\dimexpr -0.5\dimexpr {height}\relax + 0.25em\relax]{{0pt}}{{{height}}}"

lines = [
    r"\thispagestyle{empty}\noindent",
    rf"\begin{{tabular}}{{|{specs}|}}",
    r"\hline",
    rf"{strut(HEADER_HEIGHT)} & {header} \\ \hline",
]
lines += [rf"{strut(ROW_HEIGHT)} & {row} \\ \hline"] * ROWS
lines.append(r"\end{tabular}")

print("\n".join(lines))
```
